checks.name: Three distinct VARCO rope clips load
Seated players cannot use a rope
Wrong standing cannot spend cooldown
Throw starts five second cooldown immediately
The projectile travels instead of instantly hitting
Flight stays straight after the caster turns
Latched victim can still walk
Latched victim can still jump
Second press uses the swing direction and retains existing momentum
The same connection cannot pull twice
A pulled rope cannot immediately cast again
Targets behind the caster can be hit
Upward aim launches the victim upward
Gravity continues after the pull
A pull can reverse order on a flat platform without a fall
A wall blocks the projectile and still consumes cooldown
A wall crossing an attached rope breaks it
Targets farther than twelve metres are not reached
Moving beyond sixteen metres breaks the connection
A miss still cannot be recast at 4.99 seconds
A miss can be recast after five seconds
Repeated casts have no ammunition limit
A stunned caster releases the rope and cannot pull
A stunned victim can still be flung with momentum
Victim falling immediately releases the rope
Caster falling releases without refunding cooldown
Sitting during a race does not reset cooldown
Everyone seated clears rope and cooldown
Snapshots restore target and cooldown without duplicate impulses
Switching to melee releases the tether
Q input routes to the lasso
New game clears all live connections
Default pull travels toward caster, not camera forward
Default pull overcomes fast movement away from caster
Default pull stays between 4.4 and 5.2 metres in 0.3 seconds
Opposing movement limits the pull to 1.8-3 metres without cancelling it
Sideways fling still collides with a solid wall
Sideways mouse flick drives the pull
Upward flick launches upward regardless of facing
Stopping the mouse before pulling restores the default inward pull
An earlier frame's swing cannot steer a later pull
Tiny aim adjustments keep the pull directed toward the caster
Changing swing direction uses the current swing instead of old accumulated input
A stationary target near the reticle edge is forgiving
Point blank overlap catches the target
Leading a moving opponent intersects its future position
Sidestepping out of the projectile path dodges it
Original first and third person rope clips are installed
Throw audio plays once on accepted cast
Latch audio plays only when the rope reaches the victim
Pull audio plays once on the second action
Cooldown, duplicate events and pose reconciliation cannot replay sounds
Missed ropes never play latch or pull audio
The local victim hears latch audio clearly
Round reset stops every rope sound
